Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 4046 of 2025
Applicant :- Amitabh Kumar Srivastava @ Amitabh Srivastava
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru.
Its Secy. Home Lko.

And Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Desh Mitra Anand,Prateek Rawat
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Rohit Tripathi
Hon'ble Subhash Vidyarthi,J.
1. Heard Shri Desh Mitra Anand, learned counsel for the applicant, Shri Pranesh Sinha, learned
A.G.A. for the State, Shri Rohit Tripathi, the learned counsel for the Enforcement Directorate and
perused the records.
2.

The instant application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No.05 of 2020, under Sections 409, 420, 467, 468, 471, 120-B I.P.C. registered at Police Station- Gomti Nagar, District- Lucknow.

3. The aforesaid case has been registered on the basis of an F.I.R. alleging that the informant had made some investment in a Project of Shine City Infrastructure Pvt. Ltd. Company but no return was paid on his investment.

entities.text: Shine City Infrastructure Pvt. Ltd. Company
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: 4. In the affidavit filed in support of the bail application, it has been stated that the applicant has been falsely implicated in the present case.

It has further been stated that the applicant was an Additional Director of the Company since 17.03.2016 and he had resigned from the aforesaid Amitabh Kumar Srivastava @ Amitabh ... vs State Of U.P. Thru.

It has further been stated in the affidavit that the applicant had no previous criminal history but as per his knowledge, he has been roped in more than 220 F.I.R.s registered under different police stations and the learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that all the F.I.R.s relate to disputes regarding Shine City Infrastructure Pvt. Ltd. Company only.
5.

entities.text: Shine City Infrastructure Pvt. Ltd. Company
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that the applicant has been granted bail in about 100 cases.

6. Learned AGA has vehemently opposed the bail application and he has submitted that the applicant is involved in a large scale financial fraud affecting a very large number of persons and,
therefore, he is not entitled to be released on bail.
However, he could not refute the submissions of the learned counsel for the applicant that although the applicant is languishing in jail since 17.10.2020, even charges have not been framed till date.

7. Having considered the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case and keeping in view the fact that the purpose of keeping an under trial person in custody is to ensure his availability to face the trial and the trial has not even commenced in spite of a period of more than four years has been elapsed since the applicant was taken into custody, I am of the view that the aforesaid facts are sufficient for making out a case for enlargement of the applicant on bail in the aforesaid crime.
8. Accordingly, this bail application stands allowed.

. 
[Subhash Vidyarthi, J.]
Order Date :- 9.5.2025 -Amit K-
